pulls.title: 8396065: AArch64: Add relaxed semantics to AtomicAccess::PlatformXchg on Linux
pulls.author: jsikstro
pulls.body_excerpt: Hello, [JDK-8395815](https://bugs.openjdk.org/browse/JDK-8395815) replaced the usage of XchgUsingCmpxchg with a variant that uses specific LSE/exclusive instruction(s) for exchange on Linux/AArch64. In the review discussion of that issue, we agreed to follow up by adding relaxed variants for the 8-, 4-, and now 1-byte implementations of exchange, which only have a conservative implementation so far. pulls.author: VladimirIaroslavski
